review.official:
Born in Londinium in
Victoria
, Lava is the younger twin sister of her fellow
Operator
,
Hibiscus
. After contracting
Oripathy
, she came to
Rhodes Island
for treatment. She found the idea of saving lives appealing, and so volunteered for training.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9.4%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.25 u/L
Degree of infection is minor and has not had any physical impact.

Under the guidance of her Originium Arts instructor, Lava learned how to control basic Arts in less than a month despite never touching Originium before. Her methods are still rudimentary, and at present she can still only use simple flame conversions, but her stability and learning speed are astounding. If she trains for a long period of time, she may be able to reach a very high level.

Unlike other stray children hiding in dark alleys, Lava was born into a relatively normal middle-class Victorian family. Lava believes that one must personally put in effort to help others, rather than stand at a distance. When she was young, she enjoyed working with the poor and the orphaned. She was very aware how much pain they suffered, which planted in her heart the seeds of compassion and justice.

Lava is tough and ignores the advice of others when she moves into action. In fact, she is gentle and childlike at heart but prefers not to admit it to herself. Whenever anyone brings this up, she immediately changes the subject and tries to play it cool.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Need something? If you don't ,how about some divination?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Just tell me when there's work to do. But don't ever put her and me on the same team. I hate her guts. And don't get me started on all the weird food she makes me eat... Just thinking about it makes me... euurghh...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: No one told me Hibiscus was at Rhodes Island before I got here... It's too late for me to quit now.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If you grow up sheltered, you don't know how to taunt, how to destroy, and how to handle yourself in a real fight. Am I right, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Have you ever heard the saying 'little sisters are justice'? If that's true, then my big sis is evil by default... at least as far as I'm concerned.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Instruments? I can play the piano a little. My teacher in Leithanien said learning an instrument can improve your Arts affinity. It also apparently eases the impact that Oripathy has on your mind...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm starving... Huh, what's this? You keep sweets in here? Nom... I'm in the middle of training. Should I really be eating this?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: See, like, I don't have a big beef with Hibiscus... It's all water under the bridge. I'm fine with her as long as she doesn't force me to eat her medicine and food. After all, she was the one... who saved my life...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I almost envy your ability to sleep like a log...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Lava, a Caster, here to join you simply because I'm bored and want something to do… But I heard my sworn nemesis is here too, though... Can I just quit now?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Did you forget? I don't need a cause to work for, and I don't need a team... but... thanks, I guess...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As far as teamwork's concerned... I don't mind, as long as nobody messes up.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm not good at this sort of stuff, but if you insist...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go. Keep an eye on my back.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I can see their souls. They're mine to reap.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What are you waiting for?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hurry up.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Come on.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: That's it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: It's game over for you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Even the dead can't save you.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The supreme form of Arts. I'm interested in seeing what it's like.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I foresaw this result earlier. A perfect victory.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Well… My fortune telling isn't always right. Sometimes there's a lot of external noise that affects the outcome.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Dammit... These evil spirits are too strong...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh, come on. I'd rather be alone.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't touch me! Uaghh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Eh, you're not scoring any points with me like that!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I need your help, Doctor. Tell me, Just in what world do I fall under the category of 'Out of Shape?' I was feeding myself some fried-foulbeast, and that annoying Hibiscus took it away, before peeling the coat off and handing the rest back to me! The crispy, crunchy coat! She took it! Gone! There's *NO* way I can get my hands on what I want to eat with her around! There's gonna be a fight... Ugh! Never mind.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor. Morning.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here, I made you a pair of gloves. And take a look at these beautiful patterns on them! Cool, aren't they? I got them from my divination, which always comes true. You too will learn that in the future.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My infection made my sister's life hell as well. It may not look like it, but deep inside my heart resonates with hers, because what we all want is to help those in need with our hands. Speaking of which, isn't she still on shift today? Huh, how can someone have the right to call me the one that worries when she pushes herself this hard?
